Hotel: Embassy Suites by Hilton Detroit Metro Airport
Observation: The Detroit airport shuttle is described as running 24 hours.

Hotel: Hilton Garden Inn Detroit Metro Airport
Observation: The hotel advertises a complimentary DTW shuttle. The 24-hour reference on the overview describes the snack shop.
The hotel points travelers to the airport courtesy phone. The pages give no operating window.

Hotel: Home2 Suites by Hilton Taylor Detroit
Observation: The transportation section explicitly lists airport shuttle service as unavailable.
Terminals 1, 2 and 3 have a walkway. A Terminal 5 shuttle is described as subject to availability, with no hours given.

Hotel: The Rose Hotel Chicago O’Hare, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
Observation: Travelers are told to call for pickup. The pages give no airport shuttle hours.
The stated service ends at 11 p.m. on weekdays and 10 p.m. on weekends.

Hotel: Embassy Suites by Hilton Chicago O'Hare Rosemont
Observation: Complimentary O’Hare shuttle service is listed without start or end times.
The published operating window runs from 4 a.m. to 2 a.m.

Hotel: Embassy Suites by Hilton Atlanta Airport North
Observation: The hotel lists a 4 a.m. start and a 2 a.m. finish.

Hotel: Hampton Inn & Suites Atlanta Airport North I85
Observation: The published service window ends at 11:45 p.m. and resumes at 4 a.m.

Hotel: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Atlanta Airport
Observation: An airport shuttle is listed. The pages give no hours for it.
